title: Public money after the arenas opened, by what it paid for, when it comes due and who approved it
note: What it paid for (renovation, purchase, ongoing yearly payments, property-tax break), when it comes due (owed under agreements and laws already in place, or a new deal) and who approved it (voters or officials), from the view after_items; largest lists the three arenas with the most in each part.
method: with g as ( select 'what' as bar, kind as key, public_2026_m, team from after_items union all select 'due', timing, public_2026_m, team from after_items union all select 'who', approved, public_2026_m, team from after_items), t as (select bar, key, team, sum(public_2026_m) as v from g group by all) select bar, key, sum(v) as value_2026_m, count(*) as arenas, list(team order by v desc)[1:3] as largest from t group by bar, key order by case bar when 'what' then 1 when 'due' then 2 else 3 end, value_2026_m desc
